reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) describes SPS of high-entropy diborides at 2000°C, not single-phase ZrB2 at ~1950°C, and provides no data on porosity, mechanical strength, or corrosion resistance in plating baths. The key premises about densification, microstructural refinement, and performance benefits for ZrB2 are unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: SPS at ~1950°C can densify ZrB2 to near-pore-free state
SPS reduces grain growth and porosity via spark-induced heating and pressure
Dense, pore-free ZrB2 resists liquid penetration and degradation in plating baths
Conventional ZrB2 sintered above 2300°C has higher porosity and defects
